# googleworkspace_drive_permission (Resource)

Manages a single permission on a Google Drive file or shared drive via the Drive API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "googleworkspace_drive" "engineering" {
  name                    = "Engineering"
  use_domain_admin_access = true
}

resource "googleworkspace_drive_permission" "engineering_group" {
  file_id                 = googleworkspace_drive.engineering.id
  type                    = "group"
  email_address           = "engineering@example.com"
  role                    = "writer"
  use_domain_admin_access = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `file_id` (String)
- `role` (String)
- `type` (String)

### Optional

- `email_address` (String)
- `use_domain_admin_access` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique ID of this resource.
- `permission_id` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is "<use_domain_admin_access>,<file_id>/<permission_id>".
terraform import googleworkspace_drive_permission.engineering_group true,0ABcDeFgHiJkLmNoPQ/01234567890123456789
```
